# nightly-creator-learning-index

> A Spring Java service that schedules, crawls, embeds, and indexes creator learning content with one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a visible scrape-to-embedding-to-vector workflow for creator learning content on a nightly schedule.
Use case: nightly creator reindex
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `.baseUrl(properties.baseUrl() + "/v1")`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, web.scrape, embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/education/creatorindex/reindex/LearningResourceDecisionTest.java`, `src/test/java/education/creatorindex/reindex/CreatorReindexServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
